tests/colorread.test.js.name: Color reading tests
tests/colorread.test.js.description: Reads a synthetic 3x3 side exactly and the four real photos of the family's cube at least 15 of 16 squares right.

tests/core2.test.js.name: 2x2 brain tests
tests/core2.test.js.description: Checks the known photo cube's 9-turn solution, 200 random cubes, both copy orders, and that a wrong square is always caught.

tests/core3.test.js.name: 3x3 brain tests
tests/core3.test.js.description: Checks the turns against the cubejs solver, that every solution solves the cube, that a turned side is fixed, and that a wrong square is caught.

tests/load.js.name: Test loader
tests/load.js.description: Reads the source pieces straight from src and runs them so the quick checks can call the cube brains, color reading and words.

tests/run.js.name: Run all quick checks
tests/run.js.description: Runs the words, 2x2, 3x3 and color reading checks one after another; this is what npm test calls.

tests/strings.test.js.name: Words tests
tests/strings.test.js.description: Checks every sentence exists in every language with matching placeholders, well-formed plural and color sets, and no shouting or em dashes.

tests/flat.test.js.name: Flat turn tests
tests/flat.test.js.description: Checks the flat turn table against both cube models for all 27 turns: on the shown side only the named layer moves, it slides off the way the arrow points, and a front turn rotates the front a quarter.
